schoolName: Université des Comores — École de Médecine et de Santé Publique
reviewNotes: HOLD — the Comoros Ministry lists University of Comoros and its School of Medicine and Public Health (EMSP). The university's official 2025–2026 programme offer includes EMSP's Master 2 Infirmier Spécialisé en Santé Mentale, and its 2025–2026 admissions process provides a university-wide pre-enrolment timeline. However, no current undergraduate medical degree, medicine programme curriculum, fee schedule, clinical-training route, language, international eligibility or professional-recognition record was found. The national health plan's proposal to create a Faculty of Medicine is evidence that an assumed medical-doctor pathway would be unsafe. The queue's historical 'Faculty of Health Sciences' label must not be reused as a public programme assertion.
